reuse.why: No existing duplicate-link check exists in the tree; the change adds one helper built on db.first and every provider link function calls it.

duplication.why: The rule lives in one helper; only a three-line call is repeated across the five pre-existing per-provider link functions, which is the tree's existing structure.

placement.why: The guard sits in accounts/app.ts next to the link functions and runs before findOrCreateBank and any sync-server call.

scope.why: Only the helper and its five call sites are added.

maintainability.why: A clear named guard with a single query; a sixth provider would have to remember to call it, since the five link functions remain separate copies.

bypasses_abstraction.where: None; uses db.first and does not route around any existing layer.

disguised_duplication.where: The check is defined once; call sites only pass provider name and ids.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, called by all five link*Account functions.
